gap: No result ChatGPT got says that Samsung's only trackpad keyboard for the Galaxy Tab S11 line is the $399.99 Pro Keyboard (EF-DX935), sold only for the S12 Ultra and S11 Ultra. The standard Tab S11 gets only the Book Cover Keyboard Slim (EF-DX730), and Samsung lists no pointing device for it. Meanwhile, the cheaper Tab S10 FE has a $199.99 Book Cover Keyboard with a trackpad (EF-DX725), which also fits the Tab S10 Lite, S9 and S9 FE.
standout_why: I compared against mynexttablet.com/best-tablets-keyboards (cited by ChatGPT). It already says the S11 gets only the Slim cover with no touchpad, that a touchpad version exists only for the S11 Ultra, and that S7/S8/S9 covers don't fit the S11. So the core trackpad split is already on a cited rival page. What it lacks: part numbers, US prices (Pro Keyboard $399.99, S10 FE trackpad keyboard $199.99), Samsung's own compatibility lists, and the fact that Samsung US now sells the S11 Ultra keyboards as 'Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra | S11 Ultra'. ChatGPT's own answer only says 'Samsung's keyboard options also differ in whether they include a trackpad'. Wired could not be fetched (blocked). PhoneArena and TechSpot returned 403.
decides: This argues against the Tab S11 as the 'professional' keyboard pick for anyone who wants a laptop-style trackpad, since Samsung offers no trackpad keyboard for it. Among Samsung tablets, a trackpad keyboard needs either the S10 FE at +$199.99 or the S11 Ultra at +$399.99. That makes the S11 Ultra $1,299.99 + $399.99 = $1,699.98 before tax with Samsung's trackpad keyboard. It supports the S10 FE as the value pick, because its trackpad keyboard also carries over from or to the S9, S9 FE and S10 Lite.
